name: DNSCrypt Proxy
description: Smart DNS filtering with DNSCrypt. Local resolver on 127.0.0.1:5354 with per-profile blocklists (HaGeZi Light/Normal/PRO/PRO++/Ultimate), wildcard-aware Custom Rules (Allowlist + Denylist), bilingual EN/AR interface, separate monitoring Dashboard with JSON metrics, SSE live updates, and offline-capable PWA. Zero telemetry.
author: gasciljh
x-note-shortcuts: Shortcut URLs use the DEFAULT ports: 9090 for WebUI, 9091 for Dashboard. If you change PORT or DASHBOARD_PORT in webui.conf, these shortcuts will continue using the default ports. This is a fundamental limitation of the static PWA manifest format (it cannot read runtime configuration).
x-note-port-limitation: For dynamic port handling, the WebUI/Dashboard HTML/JS read the actual ports from /api?action=runtime_info (fields: webui_port, dashboard_port) and construct URLs dynamically. However, PWA shortcuts (this section) are evaluated by the browser BEFORE any JS runs, so they cannot benefit from runtime_info. See v1.0.0 PORT-2 fix in index.html and dashboard.html for the dynamic link implementation.
x-note-ports: Default ports: WebUI=9090, Dashboard=9091. Monitoring UI (internal): 8080. DNS Engine: 5354. All ports are configurable in webui.conf except 8080 (reserved for dnscrypt-proxy's monitoring_ui).
x-note-screenshots: The 'screenshots' array was intentionally removed in v1.0.0. Per PWA spec, screenshots should be actual app screenshots (not icons). Add real screenshots in a future release to enable Chrome's richer install UI.
x-note-version: The 'version' field is not standard in PWA manifest spec but is used here for documentation/troubleshooting. It mirrors VERSION file for consistency.
x-note-v1: Updated in v1.0.0: (1) Fixed two critical shortcut bugs (Control Panel was opening Dashboard due to relative URL). (2) Removed non-compliant screenshots. (3) Added version field. (4) Documented port limitations. See CHANGELOG for details.
